correctness.rationale: An added cut splitting lengths a,b removes ab inversions and adds two fixed cards just when both lengths are odd. Conditional on all other gaps, the one-bit covariance is nonpositive and is strictly negative on the all-other-gaps-cut event; the covariance of the conditional expectations is nonpositive by product-measure monotonicity. At common fixed p the complete packet lengths are geometric, and the centered rewards W have E[W]=0 and finite second moments. The complete packet count divided by n tends to p; Kolmogorov maximal bounds for centered sums over a deterministic window around np justify random-index substitution without requiring independence of the index and rewards. For the covariance limit, let M be the first renewal strictly past n. The stopped sum has mean zero and second moment E[M]E[WWᵀ] by the stopped martingale identities; M≤n+1 and E[M]=1+np. The omitted crossing length is the sum of backward age and forward residual, both uniformly geometrically bounded in tail. Replacing its reward by the unfinished packet reward is thus a uniformly L²-bounded error, giving covariance convergence by Cauchy–Schwarz. The rational covariance entries follow by differentiating the full and odd-length generating functions, with determinant positive for 0<q<1. The derivative and endpoint limits of the normalized correlation check. Neither endpoint is a nondegenerate Gaussian regime.
